name: Il Campo and Centro
description: The heart of Siena around Piazza del Campo, the fan-shaped square hosting the Palio and ringed by cafes and the Torre del Mangia. Central to all three terzi, it is the most atmospheric and connected base, though busy with visitors year round.
bestFor: Visitors wanting to live steps from Siena's iconic square and sights

name: Terzo di Camollia
tagline: Northern district with local everyday life
description: The northern third of the historic center, stretching along Via Banchi di Sopra toward Porta Camollia. More residential and workaday than Il Campo, it holds shops, trattorias and university life, offering a genuine local feel within the walls and close to the train connections.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting local life inside the walls near transport

name: Terzo di Citta
description: The southwestern third around the Duomo, Santa Maria della Scala and the Pinacoteca, filled with medieval palaces and cultural sights. Elegant and central yet slightly quieter than Il Campo, it suits those who want art and architecture on their doorstep.
bestFor: Culture lovers wanting cathedral and museums within a short walk

name: Terzo di San Martino
description: The eastern third running down toward Porta Romana, home to contrade like Leocorno and Nicchio and the Logge del Papa. Residential and less trafficked, with everyday shops and views over the Tuscan hills, it gives a calmer base still walkable to the center.
bestFor: Nomads wanting quieter residential streets and hill views near center
